claim_label: Prioritizing present-day algorithmic bias versus future existential risks
description: This conflict centers on whether society should primarily focus on the opportunity costs of delayed AI innovation, existential threats from superintelligence, or immediate harms like algorithmic bias and corporate exploitation.

instances.assertion: The biggest risk is moving too slowly and missing out on life-saving medical and scientific advancements.
The biggest risk is an unrecoverable global disaster caused by an uncontrollable, superintelligent AI.
The biggest risk is present-day corporate exploitation, such as algorithmic bias, job loss, and surveillance.
Argues we must focus on fixing built-in biases causing immediate harm, like discriminatory hiring and medical malpractice.
Argues that while present harms matter, preventing the irreversible existential risk of an unaligned superintelligence must be the top priority.
